rules.title: Missing HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS)
rules.description: The HTTP Strict Transport Security header is missing on an HTTPS response, leaving the site vulnerable to protocol downgrade attacks.
rules.remediation_template: Add 'Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains' to your HTTPS server configuration.

rules.title: Missing X-Frame-Options Header
rules.description: The X-Frame-Options or Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors directive is missing. The site may be vulnerable to Clickjacking.
rules.remediation_template: Add 'X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN' or a restrictive 'Content-Security-Policy' frame-ancestors directive.

rules.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options Header
rules.description: The X-Content-Type-Options header is missing, allowing browsers to perform MIME sniffing.
rules.remediation_template: Add 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff' to all server responses.

rules.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy
rules.description: A Content Security Policy (CSP) restricts the resources a page can load. It is absent here.

rules.title: Insecure Cookie (Missing Secure Flag)
rules.description: A cookie was set without the Secure attribute. It could be transmitted in plaintext if the user accesses the site via HTTP.
rules.remediation_template: Append the 'Secure' flag to all sensitive cookies.

rules.title: Cookie Missing HttpOnly Flag
rules.description: A cookie was set without the HttpOnly attribute, making it accessible to client-side scripts and vulnerable to XSS theft.
rules.remediation_template: Append the 'HttpOnly' flag to all Sensitive cookies.

rules.title: Server Version Disclosure
rules.description: The Server HTTP header exposes the server's identity and potentially its version number.
rules.remediation_template: Configure the web server to omit or obfuscate the 'Server' header.

rules.title: Framework Disclosure (X-Powered-By)
rules.description: The X-Powered-By HTTP header reveals the application framework running on the server.
rules.remediation_template: Remove the 'X-Powered-By' header in your application framework configuration.

rules.title: Overly Permissive CORS Policy
rules.description: The Access-Control-Allow-Origin header is set to '*', allowing any origin to interact with the resources.

rules.title: Mixed Content (HTTP links on HTTPS page)
rules.description: The HTTPS page includes resources loaded over plaintext HTTP, bypassing transport layer encryption.
rules.remediation_template: Ensure all resources (images, scripts, styles) are loaded via HTTPS.

rules.title: HTTP OPTIONS Method Allowed
rules.description: The HTTP OPTIONS method is enabled, which may expose allowed HTTP methods and API endpoints.
rules.remediation_template: Disable the OPTIONS method if it is not required for application functionality such as CORS.

rules.title: TLS/SSL Certificate Expired
rules.description: The TLS certificate for this site has expired, causing browsers to reject the connection.
rules.remediation_template: Renew and re-deploy the TLS certificate immediately.

rules.title: Missing SPF Record
rules.description: Sender Policy Framework (SPF) restricts who can send emails on behalf of a domain. Missing here.
rules.remediation_template: Publish an SPF TXT record for the domain.
